description: Marks one email in Apple Mail read and moves it to its account's archive (Archive, or Gmail's All Mail), by its id from mail_find, through Mail's scripting in the background. While the Mac is locked, it is done at the next unlock.

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

name: mail_archive
title: Archive an Email
